title: Back End Developer
description:
ZocialOne is an AI\\-powered Growth Marketing platform. One platform to create, post, schedule, reply, and analyze across 7 social media platforms — Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Threads, and Google Business Profile.
 



  





 This is a live production system used daily by 150,000\\+ businesses. Every API you write, every schema you design, and every bug you fix directly impacts real users, real data, and real revenue.
 



 We are looking for a Backend Engineer who wants to build production systems that matter — real APIs, real databases, real users.
 



  





 You join as the second backend engineer, working directly with the backend lead. Your code runs in production from week one. This is not a shadow role — you are here to build.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Build and maintain REST APIs (Express.js) consumed by web, mobile (Flutter), and our AI agent (Zoe)
* Design and evolve PostgreSQL schemas with TypeORM — users, posts, analytics, subscriptions, billing
* Integrate 7 social media platform APIs — each with its own OAuth, rate limits, webhooks, and failure modes
* Build payment and subscription systems (Razorpay) — plan enforcement, credit tracking, invoice generation
* Implement background job processing (pg\\-boss) — scheduled posting, analytics aggregation, notification delivery, retry logic
* Build real\\-time features with WebSockets (Socket.IO) — live notifications, SSE bridges, chat events
* Handle media processing pipelines — image/video uploads to GCS/S3, FFmpeg transcoding, aspect ratio handling
* Implement authentication flows — Firebase Auth, JWT, Google Sign\\-In, phone OTP, WhatsApp login
* Build the API bridge between ZocialOne and Zoe AI — content generation endpoints, credit tracking, prompt management
* Monitor, debug, and hotfix production issues — Sentry error tracking, Winston logging, production incident response



  





**What You'll Need** 



* Node.js with TypeScript — production\\-grade, not tutorial\\-level
* Express.js — routing, middleware, request validation (Zod / express\\-validator)
* PostgreSQL \\+ TypeORM — JOINs, indexes, migrations, constraints, transactions
* REST API design — proper validation, pagination, filtering, error handling, versioning
* Async programming — Promises, async/await, event loop, race conditions
* Error handling — try/catch as muscle memory, graceful degradation, structured error responses
* Git — branch, commit, review, merge, resolve conflicts



  





**Nice to have:** 



* Firebase Admin SDK
* Razorpay / payment gateway experience
* Cloud storage (GCS, S3\\)
* WebSockets / Socket.IO
* Job queues (pg\\-boss, Bull)
* FFmpeg / media processing
* Docker, CI/CD
* Sentry, monitoring tools
* Social media API experience
* Basic exposure to AI APIs (Gemini, OpenAI)



  





**Who You Are** 



* Reliable — when you say it ships Thursday, it ships Thursday
* Detail\\-oriented — a wrong number in analytics or a duplicate charge is unacceptable to you
* Fundamentally strong — you understand how databases, HTTP, and async code actually work
* Independent — you take a task end\\-to\\-end without needing step\\-by\\-step hand\\-holding
* Production\\-minded — you think about what breaks at scale, not just what works in local
* Persistent — some days you're tracing a timezone bug in a cron job; you stay until it's fixed



  





**Not a Fit If** 



* You can't write a SQL JOIN without Googling it
* You treat error handling as optional
* You've never deployed code that real users interact with
* You copy\\-paste from ChatGPT without understanding what the code does



  





**Compensation** 



* Competitive Salary aligned with your experience and the market.
* Everything you build goes to production. Not a staging server, not a test project — production. 150,000\\+ businesses use the APIs you write for their everyday marketing. That's a portfolio most engineers don't build in 5 years.
* You learn at startup speed. In 6 months here, you will touch APIs, databases, payments, social media integrations, background jobs, media processing, AI backends, and production debugging. At a large company, you'd spend that time onboarding to one microservice.
* You work with a senior backend lead who has built this entire system. Direct mentorship. Real code reviews. Not a YouTube tutorial — a production codebase.



  





**Why Join ZocialOne** 



* Your APIs serve 150,000\\+ businesses daily — real impact from day one
* You're engineer \\#2, not \\#47 — touch every part of the system in your first month
* Backend serves both human users and an AI agent (Zoe) — the future of software engineering
* Direct access to founders and product decisions — no management layers
* Production deployments weekly — your work reaches users in days, not months



  





 "Production systems are not built by people who give up when the logs don't make sense."
